outcome: Learned that the battery doesn't have to change, just the cable. Old AA holders can run the motors (count the cells: 4 AA = 6 V is the sweet spot). And going 10x faster isn't 'bigger motors': air drag grows so fast that 10x the speed needs roughly 100x the power, which means a whole different kind of motor, battery and prop.
